title: Capacity harmonization: reserved-pool fit & SLA-prioritization heuristic
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and validate a deterministic triage heuristic for enterprise reserved capacity requests that harmonizes SLA targets, reserved throughput sizing, GPU family tolerance, and scaling policy recommendations. The goal is to reduce intake time-to-decision, surface predictable fallback bands, and provide an actionable "fit score" + recommended pool topology for SRE/Capacity teams and Customer Success during onboarding.
intake_questions: Describe expected steady-state RPS or qps and 95/99 latency SLOs (ms)
What is the expected burst factor (x above steady-state) and burst duration (minutes/hours)?
Can you tolerate preemption or do you require dedicated nondisruptive hardware (yes/no)?
Which GPU families are acceptable? (A100, H100, L4, etc.)
Does the workload require KV cache warmstart or long context retention? Specify max sequence length.
Is encryption/KMS/HSM required for model artifacts or request logs?
What are the regulatory/data locality constraints (regions/VPC/on-prem)?
triage_heuristic: Fit Score computes weighted sum across four axes: Throughput Fit (40%), Latency Tail Risk (30%), GPU Compatibility (20%), Scaling Sensitivity (10%)
Throughput Fit: map qps -> tokens/s requirement -> recommended concurrent replicas; penalize >20% mismatch with pool baseline
Latency Tail Risk: convert 95/99 SLOs plus sequence length to required model/kernel path; mark high-risk when p99 < 100ms on non-dedicated instances
GPU Compatibility: binary pass/fail for preferred families; partial credit if customer accepts quantized or smaller model variants
Scaling Sensitivity: high sensitivity for workloads that cannot tolerate cold-starts or have high KV cache dependency; recommend reserved smaller pools with fast scaling paths
Threshold mapping: Fit >= 0.85 => Green (direct reserve), 0.6-0.85 => Amber (reserve + canary), <0.6 => Red (suggest hosted + opt-in Dedicated migration)
acceptance_criteria: Documented intake form used in at least 3 enterprise sales engagements and scored via the heuristic
End-to-end decision result (fit score + recommended pool config) validated with one pilot customer and SRE review
Playbook entries for 'Amber' and 'Red' outcomes including recommended fallback models, burst credit rules, and escalation contacts
Console UI prototype for showing fit score and recommendation available in product triage dashboard mock (design sign-off)
decisions: Adopt a deterministic Fit Score rather than free-form triage notes to improve cross-team handoffs
Default weightings set to Throughput 40 / Latency 30 / GPU 20 / Scaling 10 pending telemetry-driven tuning after 6 pilots
For customers that choose not to accept quantized variants, mark GPU compatibility penalty and escalate to capacity engineering for custom scheduling
Burst handling: recommend enabling burst-credit for 30% of baseline for 2 hours by default; exceptions require contract amendment
